correctness.rationale: Up to null boundary conventions each initial full vertical fiber maps to one dyadic cell. A contraction sends it to a depth-one-higher cell, and doubling modulo one sends a positive-depth cell to a cell of depth one lower (not necessarily its geometric parent). Independent ternary digits give K_n the reflected walk with up probability p=2/3 and down probability q=1/3. The conditional mean of 2^{−K} is unchanged away from zero since p/2+2q=1, and at zero it is 2/3. Thus E_{n+1}=E_n−a_n/3. The reflected depth dominates the underlying walk S_n, which tends to infinity by the strong law; bounded convergence gives the exact tail formula. Independent ballot reconstruction: K_n=S_n−min_{0≤j≤n}S_j has the law of max_{0≤j≤n}S_j by reversal of the finite increment string. Thus a_n=Pr(τ_1>n), and Pr(τ_1=2k+1)=p(pq)^k C_k for Catalan numbers C_k, by a nonpositive excursion followed by an up step. Consequently A(w)=(1−pw∑_{k≥0}C_k(pqw²)^k)/(1−w), which rationalizes to the stated A(w). The return tail starts at k=m for n=2m and k=m+1 for n=2m+1. Stirling and geometric summation give even return amplitude 12√(2/π) against ρ^n n^{−3/2} and odd amplitude ρ times it, both with relative O(1/n); these equal √(2/π)(d_+^{−2}±d_-^{−2}). Finally summing the exact E_n tail weights the two terms by 1/[3(1−ρ)] and 1/[3(1+ρ)], respectively. The errors are uniformly O(1/n) in the scaled expression and both parity constants are positive, establishing the claimed limit and comparison with 2^{−1/3}.
residual_risks: The exact result is for uniform ternary base, full fibers and lengths with boundary points immaterial. It is not a statement about arbitrary initial intervals, trajectory pairs, or a mixing rate.

value.rationale: Averaging the surviving width of a whole leaf asks a different synchronization question from almost-sure shrinking or saturation probability alone. Its exact decay exposes rare near-balanced itineraries and quantifies the exponential gap between the ensemble and typical rates. The exponent, polynomial factor and two parity amplitudes give a sharp answer for a natural observable of the original map.
residual_risks: The alternating amplitude is small but strictly nonzero. There is no claimed consequence for Hölder mixing, other parameters, or perturbed maps.
